title: 19th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/19/3/2025).
First reading of the bill to amend the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, submitted on behalf of the government by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau.
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Inguraidhoo MP Ibrahim Falah to amend Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act).
First reading of the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah North MP Hamad Abdulla to amend Law No. 10/2010 (Local Council Elections Act).
Debate on the proposed State Budget for 2026 continues, under Rule 235 of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting gave first reading to government bills amending the Constitution, the Decentralisation Act and the Local Council Elections Act, then continued the debate on the proposed 2026 State Budget.
